t: This is the former site of The London Transgender Clinic, a plastic surgery clinic in Central London that is no longer operating. It was founded by Christopher Inglefield, a plastic surgeon born in 1956. Inglefield matters here because he established the clinic, so the place reflects his work as a surgeon. The material I have is limited, so I won't say more about what the clinic did, who it served, or how it came to close. What's clear is that it began with one surgeon's decision to found it.
